purpose: City-specific discovery of official cadastral parcel geometry for Manokwari, Indonesia; failed access and source-search outcomes are not treated as evidence that no cadastre exists.
name: Manokwari

queries.query: Manokwari official cadastral map parcel land registry Indonesia ATR BPN
queries.result: Search identified the official national ATR/BPN BHUMI interactive map and ATLAS geospatial portal. It did not establish a Manokwari-bounded public parcel-polygon endpoint or safe anonymous parcel response.

queries.query: Manokwari peta bidang tanah resmi ATR BPN
queries.result: Search identified BHUMI/ATLAS as the official ATR/BPN land-map portals and references to Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Manokwari, but no public Manokwari parcel geometry response was verified.

officialSources.observation: Official BHUMI interactive map loaded anonymously. Current page JavaScript identifies the parcel layer as Geoserver layer umum:Persil at the relative service route /bhumigs/umum, described as registered land parcels. This establishes viewer configuration, not an independently verified public parcel response for Manokwari.
Official help page describes the Bidang Tanah layer and coordinate display, and says parcel search can use NIB, HAK, or NIBEL. No Manokwari-specific geometry or schema was exposed by the page.

Official ATR/BPN ATLAS portal was identified as a geospatial data portal. Its public landing page did not provide a verified Manokwari parcel download or bounded safe ID+geometry response in this attempt.
Official ATR/BPN legal-information page confirms the national cadastral base-map regulatory context; it is general agency evidence, not city coverage evidence.

requests.outcome: Reached anonymously over TLS. Current Next.js page and JavaScript bundles were saved in ignored scratch space and inspected. No login or credential use.

Bundle inspection found the current Geoserver parcel-layer configuration (umum:Persil, /bhumigs/umum) and an authenticated getPersil path. The login path was not called because credentials/private tokens are prohibited.
The relative viewer route returned the BHUMI 404 page when addressed as a direct WMS endpoint; no schema, CRS, or layer response was obtained.

requests.method: GET bounded GetFeatureInfo probe at exact WUP vicinity
requests.outcome: The guessed direct WMS route returned the BHUMI 404 page. This is an endpoint-route failure only, not evidence of no parcel at the point or no citywide coverage.

Proxy rejected the tested relative route as an unparsable URL and rejected the same-origin guessed WMS URL while parsing an HTML error response. No upstream parcel data was returned; no bypass was attempted.

registryBasis: ATR/BPN national viewer and general legal/portal sources were evidenced. A Manokwari-specific first-party registry map/procedure or exposed local parcel service was not independently verified in this bounded attempt; registryFound remains null.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: National ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS land-map and parcel-layer entry points.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No Manokwari-bounded public parcel polygon response, schema/CRS, or safe native parcel ID was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The viewer may resolve the relative Geoserver route only through browser runtime state or an unobserved upstream service. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, registration, or personal fields were requested. Exact WUP coordinates were preserved in latitude/longitude order.
